# Copilot review instructions

Canonical policy: [`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md).
Download and legal scope: [`../docs/providers.md`](../docs/providers.md).

Copilot reviews this repo at **Ready/final** HEAD only; do not expect
Draft-loop Copilot rounds. Follow those documents for review scope,
secret handling, and review output. Copilot `APPROVED` is not the GitHub
merge gate; submit a review on HEAD even when the event is COMMENTED.
